title: Literary Parody, Stylistic Mimicry, and Philosophical Wit

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Frigyes Karinthy was the uncrowned king of Budapest coffee-house wit (*kávéházi kultúra*). His masterwork *Így írtok ti* (That's How You Write) is a famous collection of literary parody: exaggerating an author's stylistic idiosyncrasies so precisely that the parody reveals the essence of the original.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Karinthy took humor very seriously: in his view it was a way of thinking about the world, not mere entertainment.
